pages.title: Entangled Link
pages.text: Half of a store of entangled photon pairs, sitting on a block's face. Links tuned to one channel share it: senders pull items, fluids and energy out of what they sit on, receivers push them in - at any distance, even into another dimension. 16 items, 4,000 mB and 262,144 FE a tick.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Entanglement.
